svg.title: Royalty Rates Licensees Actually Offer
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-pitch-royalty-buckets; chapter number: 4; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Royalty Rates Licensees Actually Offer; subtitle: Where a pitched consumer product lands on wholesale; total range: 2.5% to 10% of wholesale; caption: Stephen Key estimates 20 to 30 companies per deal, with success at six to seven follow-ups spaced every five days; the royalty a pitch lands depends on the channel and the licensee.; assumptions note: Bucket edges are the rates named by Mark Reyland and Andrew Krauss; Reyland cites the National Royalty Guide average. Single-point figures are plotted with equal low and high.; note: Attributed to Mark Reyland and inventRightTV (Andrew Krauss, Stephen Key).; buckets: label: As Seen On TV deals; low: 2.5; high: 2.5; notes: Reyland puts these deals near 2.5 percent.; label: Companies holding firm; low: 5; high: 5; notes: Krauss says many companies still hold at 5 percent.; label: Most deals done; low: 6; high: 6; notes: Reyland reports most of his deals near 6 percent.; label: Guide average to ceiling; low: 8; high: 10; notes: 8 percent National Royalty Guide average; 10 percent ceiling.
